properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured on 0.87.0): the premise-truth predicate had no arm for a finding or for history, one truth value served both the chain walk and the reader, and only Inference endpoints marked a line of reasoning
properties.source: crates/reflow2-core/tests/a_premise_has_a_truth_and_a_proof_reads_correct.rs, run on main c9e6ca4 against fixtures exported read-only from flo2.io (π+e 082888103637f0e7, Arrow 6308149cf93f7723, Brocard dd55db78c7cccda8, a slice of reflow2 around the proof of concept's case 1)
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause, fetched fresh), 2026-10-18, building req:the-records-a-choice-rests-on-carry-a-truth-and-a-counter-argument-is-its-own-statement and req:a-correct-proof-reads-correct-assumptions-objections-and-conditional-claims.

1 OBSERVED (fact:reasoning-embedded-in-a-traditional-design-works-within-one-design-and-stops-at-premises-with-no-truth-and-at-design-borders-2026-10-18 and the three proof trials, reproduced on 0.87.0): a measured TemporalFact premise read "reflow2 computes no truth for a TemporalFact"; a reply to the objection a ChangeEvent carried read that ChangeEvent `fails`; an accepted Decision with an incomplete chain read its chain's verdict alone; reasoning_report showed a Decision's `decision` text, not its `chose`; π+e's supposition and Arrow's 8 discharged assumptions were listed `unsupported`; Brocard's `req:conj-finitely-many` read `truth: holds` beside `proof_status: conditional`; Brocard's Scholze-Stix objection, and a settled reinstatement chain in a scratch argumentation graph, were detect_defects contradictions. NOT affected: steps over checks, requirements, capabilities, accepted decisions and constraints.

2 PRECEDENT: search_design on the raw texts found no earlier cause.

3 CANDIDATES walked in the code (inference.rs, reasoning.rs, heal.rs): (a) own_truth's per-type match had no TemporalFact arm, so the default arm answered; (b) truth_uncached applied a holding objection to every node type, history included; (c) a concluded node's truth was its steps' verdict whatever its status; (d) claim_reading's `says` tried `decision` before any other Decision field; (e) the unsupported list filtered on truth and support alone and the walk reaches every premise, assumed ones included; (f) ClaimReading.truth was premise_truth, the value the chain walk needs (holds, under assumptions) rather than the one a reader needs; (g) the contradiction rule exempted only a refutation that holds, and is_a_standing_refutation counted only Inference endpoints as reasoning, so an answered or standing objection between statements was a defect; (h) the observation is wrong. Each was confirmed by the failing test that pins it and by its fix turning that test green; (h) was refuted by reproducing every case on the fixtures.

4 CLASS: the truth reflow2 computes for the CHAIN (a premise inside an argument) was served unchanged to the READER and to the detectors, and "in a line of reasoning" was read from Inference edges alone. Fixed at both: the reader's truth is its own (`conditional`, acceptance beside the chain), and a statement (statement_kind or taken_as_given) is reasoning.

5 PINNED by 12 class tests over six designs; 10 failed on main first (the other two pin that a counter-argument as its own statement is answered there, and that an accidental contradiction is still reported).

6 NOT ESTABLISHED: whether reflow2's own TemporalFacts all deserve to hold when used as premises (1,019 are measured; the rule reads basis, not quality).
